description: This file contains utility functions for dynamically importing instances from modules or remote storage (S3/GCS), including functions for loading modules, handling remote URLs, and validating return types of custom validators.

methods.name: get_instance_fn
methods.description: Dynamically imports and returns an instance from a module specified by a string, supporting remote URLs and local modules.

methods.name: _load_instance_from_remote_storage
methods.description: Loads an instance from a remote S3 or GCS URL by downloading the module and importing it.

methods.name: validate_custom_validate_return_type
methods.description: Validates that a given function's return type is annotated as Literal[True].
